مُؤَنَّفٌ (assumed tropical:) Sharpened at its extremity; or pointed; (M, K;) applied to a spear-head, or an arrowhead, or a blade, (K,) or anything. (M.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) Made even: a thong, or strap, made of a certain measure, and evenly. (M.) ＝
-A2- إِبِلٌ مُؤَنَّفَةٌ (assumed tropical:) Camels with which one pursues repeatedly, or gradually, or step by step, after the first of the herbage; and so ↓ مُؤْنَفَةٌ : (M:) and the former epithet is applied to sheep or goats. (K.) ―
-b2- The former of these two epithets, applied to a woman, signifies (assumed tropical:) Just married or bedded, (الَّتِى ٱسْتُؤْنِفَتْ بِالنِّكَاحِ,) for the first time. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
